reason: Checked Wildon Lemma 6.10 complete induction, including the all-x-greater-than-all-y inequality and why sorting columns preserves the strict order. Complete scaffold proof route: First sort each column of any tableau; the column sign rule changes its polytabloid only by ±1. For a column-standard but nonstandard t choose an adjacent row inversion t(q,j)>t(q,j+1). Take X from column j at rows q,…,λ′_j and Y from column j+1 at rows 1,…,q; then |X|+|Y|=λ′_j+1 and every x∈X exceeds every y∈Y. Use Garnir representatives consisting of disjoint swaps of equal-sized subsets of X,Y, including identity. The relation isolates e_t as a sum of polytabloids of nonidentity swaps. Re-sort each resulting column, using only a sign; in every term the largest label whose column changes comes from X and moves one column right, so the new column-standard tableau is strictly above t in the finite column order. Reverse induction terminates at row- and column-standard tableaux.
